title: git_commit (Phase 7) precedes Phase 9 signal writes and Phase 10 event writes; post-run artifacts uncommitted and run tag points to incomplete commit
description:
In run.skill.md and spec.skill.md, the git_commit call (Phase 7) and tag_run call (Phase 8) execute before Phase 9 signal catalogue updates and Phase 10 event file writes. This has three concrete consequences:

1. Signal catalogue changes made in Phase 9 (incrementing occurrence counts on existing signals, writing suppression signals on QA fail, writing new signals observed during the run) are not captured in the Phase 7 commit. They remain as uncommitted files at skill exit.

2. The run completion event file written in Phase 10 is also not committed.

3. The run tag (Phase 8) points to the Phase 7 commit, which is missing all Phase 9/10 artifacts. The canonical tag for a run therefore describes an incomplete repository state — the tag cannot be used as a reliable snapshot of the run's full output.

Specific uncommitted paths observed at Ariadne run exit (ed4db31a-ae77-4d84-8896-cc20d148d3e9): .moeb/signals/catalogue/9c0e1f2a-….signal.json, .moeb/signals/index.md, .moeb/events/20260610T173158Z_ed4db31a-….event.json.

This signal supersedes fa000001-0607-4000-8000-000000000001, fa000002-0607-4000-8000-000000000002, fa000003-0607-4000-8000-000000000003, fa000004-0607-4000-8000-000000000004, which were specific per-file instances of the same structural defect observed in spec.skill.md runs on 2026-06-07. Related: e7f8a9b0 covers the QA-gate-failure path where the same ordering problem causes additional post-tag harness files to go untagged; the root cause and fix are identical.

Forwarded from Ariadne signal f2a3b4c5-d6e7-4f8a-9b0c-1d2e3f4a5b6c.
proposed_resolution: Move git_commit (Phase 7) and tag_run (Phase 8) to after Phase 9 and Phase 10 complete in both run.skill.md and spec.skill.md. The revised phase order is: … → Phase 9 (QA gate + signal updates) → Phase 10 (event write) → Phase 7 (git_commit) → Phase 8 (tag_run). The commit message convention does not change. This ensures all artifacts produced during the run — including signal updates, the completion event, and any QA-fail suppression signals — are captured in a single atomic commit that the run tag points to. Address alongside e7f8a9b0 for the QA-fail amend path, which benefits from the same reordering.
